info.title: SSH Workbench API
info.description: Same-origin, single-owner API. Every write and WebSocket upgrade requires an exact Origin. Protected writes additionally require X-CSRF-Token, obtained from the authenticated /auth response. SSH credentials are used in memory unless the owner explicitly saves them into the encrypted vault; responses never contain secrets. Connections are asynchronous attempts that may ask for host-key confirmation or keyboard-interactive answers. Byte streaming is specified separately in terminal-protocol.md.
